purpose: Warehouse receipt convention, not proof of scientific comparability
grain: one terminal per dataset, model/configuration, protocol, horizon and training seed
scale: per-channel training-fitted StandardScaler; no inverse transform for these normalized metric names
reduction: mean over all scored window x forecast-step x target-channel elements, not an unweighted average of batch means
precision: author reduction and dtype recorded explicitly; independent float64 diagnostics use distinct metric names
population: exact ordered origins and targets bound by digest; shared with naive; elements = windows * horizon * target_channels
tag_encoding: string values in terminal tags; metrics retain the existing nine-field governed metric schema
published_values: Only with exact source/table/protocol in a separate reference record; never label a published number as our measured result
replicas: Store individual seeds first; report seed mean, sample SD ddof=1 and n separately. Seed SD is not temporal sampling uncertainty.
horizon_average: Separate aggregate only for the complete declared horizon population; never mix it with single-horizon records
optional_metrics: RMSE may be reported separately. MAPE/MSPE require a declared zero-target policy and finite values; never force them into primary MSE/MAE comparisons.
compatibility: No table migration required. Historic MSE rows with unit z remain unchanged; this convention labels new MSE rows z^2.
enforcement_scope: Producer contract for upcoming benchmark runs; the general-purpose warehouse is not a scientific verifier and is not changed to reject all other metrics
source_note: Formula audit on 2026-09-28; each scientific run must pin its actual author commit, preprocessing, split, scorer and protocol before comparison
